description: Physical SQLite database maintenance, backups, integrity checks, and Git VCS state sync. Supported actions: backup (online SQLite backup), restore (destructive restore from backup), audit (foreign keys and physical integrity check), merge (merge external SQLite state DB), branch_diff (diff state nodes across git branches), branch_merge (resolve graph conflicts during branch merge).

action.description: The database administration or VCS sync action to execute.

backupPath.description: Source backup file path for restore.

force.description: Force overwrite during restore or merge.

outputPath.description: Target destination file path for backup.

sourcePath.description: Source SQLite database path for merge.

target_branch.description: Target git branch to compare or merge against.

name: manage_database
